messages:
oliver (prod-eng): Starting post-deploy verification for v2.4.2 in us-west. Rolling to 20% (staggered). Plan: run micro-probes (synth-echo, kv-scan), health pings, and quick trace sampling.
deploy-bot: Deploy job started: rollout/v2.4.2 -> us-west-canary (20%)
tasha (eng-releases): checklist paste: `./ci/smoke/micro_probe.sh --env=us-west --routes=gen,embed --samples=40`
mika (sre): kicked off probes. thresholds: p95>200ms alert, 5xx>0.5% page.
deploy-bot: Micro-probe run 1/3: kv-scan ok, synth-echo probe returned 200 for gen-route, embed-route p95=145ms
ops-bot: alert (non-paging): synth-echo B latency jitter on embed-route (p95 spike 260ms) at t+65s
mika (sre): saw the jitter. tracing: high tail on worker-12 container, OOM not flagged but memory climb. tagging @tasha
tasha (eng-releases): can you run targeted replay excluding worker-12? `./ci/smoke/replay.sh --exclude worker-12`
mika (sre): running replay now.
deploy-bot: Micro-probe run 2/3 (excl worker-12): embed p95=150ms, gen p95=130ms, 5xx=0
oliver (prod-eng): good. two approaches: (A) continue ramp to 50% and monitor host drain, (B) pin embed to previous stable and ramp gen only. Thoughts?
tasha (eng-releases): prefer (B) to shrink blast radius. we can pin embed -> v2.4.0 for now and keep gen at v2.4.2.
mika (sre): agree. add auto-fallback rule: if embed p95 > 220ms OR token errors > 0.4% sustained 2m, fallback to v2.4.0.
ops-bot: Rollout update: us-west-canary -> gen-route=v2.4.2 (20%), embed-route=v2.4.0 (stable)
tasha (eng-releases): updated release notes draft: "v2.4.2: gen latency improvements; embed pinned pending memory growth investigation"
mika (sre): uploaded synthetic logs: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/rollouts/4456789012/v2.4.2/micro_probes.tar.gz
oliver (prod-eng): scheduling host-12 inspection in maintenance window. if embed stays stable for 30m we can unpin and proceed.
deploy-bot: Progress t+10m: gen p95=128ms, embed (pinned) p95=142ms, 5xx=0. No paging alarms.
mika (sre): setting a temporary alert for embed memory climb > 70% to warn early.
tasha (eng-releases): closing thread, moving ongoing monitoring to #eng-runtime. Add note to rollout: host-12 investigation required in next 8h. :white_check_mark:
